# Appian Community

> > The central hub for Appian low-code platform resources, including architecture guides, development best practices, and community-driven knowledge.

Appian Community serves as the primary knowledge base and collaboration platform for developers, architects, and business users working with the Appian low-code application development platform. The site provides comprehensive documentation on process models, integrations, database optimization, and design patterns.

## Key Topics

- Appian
- Appian Records
- AppMarket
- low-code-development
- architecture
- process-models
- database-optimization
- integrations
- testing
- design-patterns
- playbooks

## Architecture & Design

- [Appian Community](https://community.appian.com/success/p/architecture): Architecture guides for Appian low-code development and design patterns
